verdict.rationale: Daytona documents warm pools that keep a configured number of running sandboxes, plus millisecond spin-up and shutdown. That implies it can run many sandboxes at once, but nothing in the pack states concurrency limits, quotas or fleet-scale guarantees. Missing for 10: documented concurrency limits/quotas, explicit large-fleet concurrency documentation, independent or hands-on evidence of fleet-scale runs.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can run large concurrent fleets of sandboxes with documented concurrency limits

citations.quote: keep a configured number of pre-created, running sandboxes built from a snapshot; matching sandbox create requests claim one warm sandbox from the pool instantly instead of provisioning a new sandbox
Daytona lets you spin up sandboxes in milliseconds and shut them down just as fast.
